spec.goal: Freeze the P0 schema-contract seam for the vv cross-scope impact extension: four artifact XML templates (impact, paths, program, plan-deletes), the spec_guard_census host tool contract, the lint rule registry, and a seam README — plus this dogfood program and package spec. P1-P4 consume these schemas; P0 implements no enforcement.
spec.architecture: CLASSIFY_BOUNDARY: domain-only. All changes are additive files within the dsh-plugins workspace (agent-presets skill references + dsh-vv-spec-guard/schemas + .vvoc artifacts). No packages/platform surface, no existing SKILL.md / plugin code / profile modification. The seam separates agent-facing XML artifact templates (consumed by P2/P3 skills) from host-facing JSON tool contracts (consumed by P1 spec-guard). The lint.ts verdict engine stays zero-dependency; the census is a separate host tool contract.

C-ARTIFACT-SCHEMAS.name: Artifact XML templates
C-ARTIFACT-SCHEMAS.responsibility: impact / paths / program / plan-deletes templates following unique-tag, no-attribute convention; fill-in placeholders matching spec-template.xml style

C-HOST-CONTRACTS.name: Host tool contracts
C-HOST-CONTRACTS.responsibility: census-contract.json (input/output JSON schema + worktree/DI/digest/partition/lifecycle semantics) + lint-rules.json (rule names + when + owner + mode + inputs) + README seam manifest

spec.data-flow: P0 schemas are consumed downstream: P2/P3 skills load the XML templates to author artifacts; P1 spec-guard implements spec_guard_census per census-contract.json and the rules per lint-rules.json; the host computes census output and passes digests to the pure lint engine for comparison.
spec.error-handling: Contract faithfulness errors (schema drift from §14.5/§20) are caught by P0 acceptance review. Well-formedness errors in templates are caught by XML parsing. JSON schema validity is checked by a JSON parser. No runtime error handling in P0 (no enforcement code).

testing.strategy: Well-formedness of all four XML templates + dogfood program/spec; JSON validity of census-contract.json + lint-rules.json; faithfulness to the design doc §14.5/§20 (host-computed fields, unique-tag identities, DI-aware usage, digest analyzer-state, host/engine split, gate policy).
testing.coverage: Each template instantiates its schema; the dogfood program instantiates P-Id nodes, dep-P refs, owns-components, INV-N; the dogfood spec instantiates paths P-NNN plus program membership links. spec_guard_lint and spec_guard_approve run on the dogfood package.

non-goals.NG-001: Enforcement code (spec_guard_census implementation, lint rules, CDATA parser, generation-gap fix) — P1.
non-goals.NG-002: Skill SKILL.md wiring (vv-spec impact/paths/decomposition, vv-plan deletes/consumer-coverage) — P2/P3.
non-goals.NG-003: Execution feedback (reason codes, ADD-NNN addendum, AMEND-GRANT, panel states, undeclared-deletion) — P4.
non-goals.NG-004: v2 items (weighted threshold, transitive census, submodule census, panel impact chip) — P5.
non-goals.NG-005: Any modification to existing SKILL.md, plugin runtime code, or the DSH profile — P0 is additive only.
